descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de autovehicule
Responsibilities: 
Support customer development teams and guide the transition from fail-silent to fail-operational systems.
Develop and review safe hardware and software architectures for software-defined vehicles (SDV), considering relevant technologies and standards.
Create, analyze, and align system- and ECU-level functional safety concepts and requirements, and decompose them into hardware and software levels.
Conduct safety analyses, evaluate system availability, and ensure sufficient independence of redundant paths.
Verify the effectiveness of error detection, handling, and safety mechanisms.
Apply advanced methodologies for analyzing fail-operational systems and contribute to their continuous improvement.
Collaborate closely with internal safety experts and technology specialists.
Support system (ECU-level) architecture and software quality according to AUTOSAR, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), and ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity).
Act as a technical interface between customers and development teams, providing feedback on product quality and usage.
 Qualifications: 
Previous experience in HW testing or development
Experience with vehicle and ECU-level architectures; familiarity with safety concepts is a strong plus.
Strong system-level thinking and background in embedded system architectures.
Knowledge of automotive technologies such as real-time embedded software on mid/high-end SoCs, Classic and Adaptive AUTOSAR, SOA, and automotive networking protocols.
Understanding of ISO 26262, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), and ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity).
Excellent intercultural and communication skills to foster strong collaboration with customers.
Customer- and service-oriented mindset with high social and technical competence.
Mobility and flexibility to meet project needs.
